{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=18|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**Two reported [[Jaish-e-Mohammed]] militants, one civilian and four Indian soldiers are killed in a skirmish in the  [[Pulwama district]] of [[Jammu and Kashmir|Indian-administered Kashmir]] as police search for suspects in Thursday's [[2019 Pulwama attack|suicide attack that killed 40]] [[Central Reserve Police Force|Indian paramilitary police]]. [https://arynews.tv/en/indian-army-kill-abdul-rasheed-ghazi/ (arynews)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**Twin explosions in [[Idlib]], [[Syria]], kill 24 people and injure more than 20. [https://www.dailysabah.com/syrian-crisis/2019/02/18/at-least-24-killed-25-injured-in-twin-explosions-in-syrias-idlib (Daily Sabah)]
*A [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] kills the bomber and three [[Egyptian National Police|police officers]] in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]]. Two others are injured. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/suicide-bombing-in-cairo-kills-two-police-officers-11550534617 (Wall Street Journal)]
;International relations
*A [[Summit (meeting)|summit]] between [[Israel]] and the [[Visegrád Group]] (the [[Czech Republic]], [[Hungary]], [[Poland]] and [[Slovakia]]) is cancelled following Poland's reaction and withdrawal as a result of Israeli officials' statements on [[the Holocaust]] alleging Polish involvement. Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] says Israel will hold bilateral talks with the three prime ministers attending. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47277147 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[List of mass shootings in the United States in 2019]]
**Four people are killed in a shooting at a home in [[Solon Township, Kent County, Michigan]], United States, with police investigating it as a possible [[murder–suicide]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/four-people-found-dead-michigan-home-police-investigating-possible-murder-n972866 (NBC News)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/michigan-shooting-today-multiple-people-dead-cedar-springs-2019-2-18-live-updates/ (CBS News)]
;Politics and elections
*[[National Emergency Concerning the Southern Border of the United States]]
**Sixteen states sue [[Presidency of Donald Trump|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], calling his national emergency declaration made last week "unlawful and unconstitutional". [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/02/18/donald-trump-california-sues-over-national-emergency-delcaration/2911625002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[History of the Labour Party (UK)|History of the UK Labour Party]]
**Seven [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MPs]] ([[Chuka Umunna]], [[Luciana Berger]], [[Angela Smith (Sheffield MP)|Angela Smith]], [[Chris Leslie]], [[Gavin Shuker]], [[Ann Coffey]] and [[Mike Gapes]]) resign from the party, forming a new [[The Independent Group|independent group]], in protest at [[Jeremy Corbyn]]'s leadership, and "institutional anti-Semitism" within the party. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47278902 (BBC)]
*[[2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit Vietnam]]
**The [[United States]] is discussing exchanging liaison officers with [[North Korea]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/18/politics/us-north-korea/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**In a speech, [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] urges the [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|Venezuelan military]] to abandon [[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] or "lose everything". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-trump/trump-urges-venezuelan-military-to-abandon-maduro-or-lose-everything-idUSKCN1Q71G8 (Reuters)]
*[[North Korea–Vietnam relations]]
**[[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] will meet with [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam|Vietnamese General Secretary]] and [[President of Vietnam|President]] [[Nguyễn Phú Trọng]] in [[Hanoi]] ahead of talks with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://video.foxnews.com/v/6003478402001/#sp=show-clips (Fox News)]
*[[United States Deputy Attorney General]] [[Rod Rosenstein]] is reported to be stepping down from his position in mid-March. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia-rosenstein/deputy-attorney-general-rosenstein-to-step-down-in-march-official-idUSKCN1Q805B (Reuters)], [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/deputy-ag-rod-rosenstein-expected-to-step-down-by-mid-march-official-says (Fox News)]
